lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters organized into at least five horizontal rows and eight vertical columns, located posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs to form a rectangular lattice of high-intensity anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges running across the upper flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the dorsal-facing edge to shadow on the ventral-facing edge.
